# Example Session: Full Story Lifecycle — /story-readiness → Implement → /story-done

**Context:** Solo indie dev, mid-production sprint. Movement system GDD + architecture complete. Story for movement core impl generated by `/create-stories`.

**Starting State:**
- `design/gdd/movement-system.md` — complete, 8 sections
- `design/architecture/movement-adr-001.md` — Status: Accepted
- `.ags/project/sprints/sprint-03.md` — lists STORY-MOV-001 in backlog
- `.ags/project/stories/STORY-MOV-001.md` — exists, not validated
- No impl code yet

**Session Duration:** ~50 min
**Turns:** 13
**Outcome:** Story validated ready, implemented, verified complete via `/story-done`

---

## Phase 1: Story Readiness Check

### Turn 1: User Runs Readiness Check

**User:**
> /story-readiness .ags/project/stories/STORY-MOV-001.md

### Turn 2: Agent Validates Story

**Agent (via /story-readiness):**
> Reading `.ags/project/stories/STORY-MOV-001.md`...
>
> **STORY-MOV-001: Implement Rigidbody2D movement with terrain modifiers**
>
> Running 4 validation checks:
>
> **1. Design Completeness**
> - GDD ref: `design/gdd/movement-system.md` ✅
> - Section coverage: Detailed Rules ✅, Formulas ✅, Edge Cases ✅
> - TR-IDs embedded: TR-MOV-001 through TR-MOV-008 ✅
>
> **2. Architecture Completeness**
> - ADR ref: `design/architecture/movement-adr-001.md` ✅
> - ADR status: **Accepted** ✅ *(BLOCKED if Proposed)*
> - Manifest version in story: `2026-03-10` — current: `2026-03-10` ✅
>
> **3. Scope Clarity**
> - AC: 9 items, all measurable ✅
> - Out-of-scope listed: swimming, climbing ✅
> - Ambiguities: **1**
>   - ⚠️ Story says "roll direction follows last input direction" but GDD says "roll in movement direction" — conflict when player stops + immediately rolls. Clarify before pickup.
>
> **4. Definition of Done**
> - Tests required: unit tests for formula functions ✅
> - Integration event: `OnStaminaEvent` must fire correctly ✅
>
> ---
> **Verdict: NEEDS WORK**
>
> One ambiguity must resolve before impl. Resolve now to mark ready?

### Turn 3: User Resolves Ambiguity

**User:**
> Roll uses last movement direction. If player is standing still, roll uses facing direction instead.

### Turn 4: Agent Updates Story

**Agent:**
> Updating story Detailed Rules:
>
> > Roll direction: last movement direction. If velocity is zero at roll input, roll uses current facing direction.
>
> May I write to `.ags/project/stories/STORY-MOV-001.md` and set Status `ready-for-dev`?

**User:**
> Yes

**Agent writes update. Story status: `ready-for-dev`.**

> **Verdict: READY**
> Implementation-ready. Pick up when ready.

---

## Phase 2: Implementation

### Turn 5: User Starts Implementation

**User:**
> Let's implement STORY-MOV-001. I'm ready to start coding.

### Turn 6: Agent Reads Story and ADR

**Agent (gameplay-programmer):**
> Reading `.ags/project/stories/STORY-MOV-001.md`, `design/gdd/movement-system.md`, `design/architecture/movement-adr-001.md`...
>
> **Architecture (from ADR-001):**
> - `MovementComponent.cs` — MonoBehaviour on player, not singleton
> - Terrain modifier lookup via `TerrainLayer.GetModifier(tilePosition)` helper
> - Stamina events via C# event (not direct StaminaSystem call)
>
> **Proposed file structure:**
> ```
> Assets/Scripts/Gameplay/Movement/
>   MovementComponent.cs        # Rigidbody2D logic, state machine
>   TerrainModifierTable.cs     # Const table: terrainType -> {speedMod, drainMod}
> tests/Unit/
>   MovementFormulasTests.cs    # Unit tests for speed/drain calculations
> ```
>
> Proceed?

**User:**
> Yes

### Turn 7: Agent Implements, Shows Key Code

**Agent:**
> Implementing `MovementComponent.cs`. Key excerpt for review before write:
>
> ```csharp
> public class MovementComponent : MonoBehaviour
> {
>     public event Action<string, float> StaminaEvent;
>
>     [SerializeField] private float baseWalkSpeed = 120.0f;
>     [SerializeField] private float runMultiplier = 1.7f;
>     [SerializeField] private float staminaDrainWalk = 2.0f;
>     [SerializeField] private float staminaDrainRun = 6.0f;
>     [SerializeField] private float staminaCostRoll = 15.0f;
>
>     private bool isCarryingHeavy = false;
>
>     private void FixedUpdate()
>     {
>         var terrainMod = GetTerrainModifier();
>         var effectiveSpeed = CalculateSpeed(terrainMod);
>         // ...
>     }
> }
> ```
>
> All `[SerializeField]` — no hardcoded. Right direction?

**User:**
> Looks good. Write it.

### Turn 8–9: Agent Writes Files and Tests

**Agent writes:**
- `Assets/Scripts/Gameplay/Movement/MovementComponent.cs`
- `Assets/Scripts/Gameplay/Movement/TerrainModifierTable.cs`
- `tests/Unit/MovementFormulasTests.cs`

**Agent:**
> Files written. Lint check...
>
> No errors. 6 unit tests covering:
> - Walk speed (3 terrain types)
> - Run speed
> - Stamina drain calc
> - Roll stamina cost (with + without zero-velocity edge case)
>
> Manual testing needed: iframes, slope blocking, terrain integration (requires scene).

---

## What This Demonstrates

- **Readiness gate catches real issues**: roll direction ambiguity would cause late impl decision without `/story-readiness`
- **ADR status is hard gate**: if `movement-adr-001.md` was `Proposed`, story would be `BLOCKED`, impl wouldn't start
- **Deferred criteria**: not every AC verifiable at close — `/story-done` tracks deferred, not blocked
- **TR-ID references**: story stores `TR-MOV-001` IDs, not quoted GDD text — no false deviation flags when GDD wording cleaned up
- **sprint-status.yaml**: single source of truth, updated by `/story-done`, read by `/sprint-status`
- **Manifest version check**: ensures story guidance not drifted from current architecture
